brief: The temple library at night: Dhūmaka, now silver and glowing, rises from the desk in a spiral like smoke from a lamp just put out, smiling and waving; the half-burnt leaf blazes gold with its first line lit; you (seen from behind), Dādī and Śuka look up in wonder.
notes: Painting reviewed against its exact source brief. Every visible text string compared with the recorded source text; reference font inspected when needed. This is direct visual review, not an OCR-service result.
